project.title: Ava's Portal
project.concept: A young girl discovers a mysterious portal inside an abandoned city and enters a hidden world where time has stopped.
project.description: A cinematic emotional anime adventure about discovery, mystery, danger and hope.

story.hook: As the last rays of sunlight faded from the abandoned city, a young girl named Ava felt an inexplicable pull towards a mysterious portal hidden behind a crumbling wall.
story.beginning: Ava had always been drawn to the abandoned city, where rumors of a secret world had long been whispered among the locals. One day, she decided to explore the ruins, and the portal beckoned her to step through its shimmering veil.
story.middle: In the hidden world, time stood still. Ava marveled at the beauty of frozen flowers, the songs of silenced birds, and the people who had been trapped in this eternal moment. But as she delved deeper into the world, she began to notice that something was amiss. A figure, shrouded in shadows, watched her every move.
story.climax: Ava confronted the figure, who revealed himself to be the guardian of the world. He explained that time had stopped to allow the inhabitants to escape the chaos of the outside world, but at a terrible cost: their memories. Ava realized that she had the power to break the cycle and restore time, but at a personal cost.
story.ending: With a heavy heart, Ava made the choice to break the cycle. As she did, the world around her began to thaw, and the people began to remember their lives. But as she stepped back through the portal, she knew that she had lost a piece of herself, leaving behind a world forever changed, and a memory that would haunt her forever.
